args.message:
Upgrade fastjson 2.8.0 -> 2.9.4 to fix CVE-2026-31337

CVE-2026-31337 (high severity): unbounded recursion when parsing deeply
nested arrays, affecting fastjson <2.9.4 and >=3.0.0 <3.1.0. Bump to
2.9.4, the lowest fixed version in the current major version line.

args.body:
## What
Bump `fastjson` from 2.8.0 to 2.9.4 in `requirements.txt`.

## Why
fastjson 2.8.0 is affected by CVE-2026-31337 (high severity): unbounded recursion when parsing deeply nested arrays. Versions affected: <2.9.4 and >=3.0.0 <3.1.0. 2.9.4 is the lowest fixed release in the 2.x line.

## Testing
- CI run `ci-0001` on commit c8b8ab7878: **passed**.
